## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and reason for this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks passed; attach results and note unexecuted checks.
- [ ] English / 简体中文 UI and docs updated where needed.
- [ ] Security, privacy, failure handling and dependency licenses considered.
- [ ] `docs/project-status.md` reflects shipped scope and remaining work.

Feature PRs target `dev`; release PRs target `main` from `dev`.
